resources.string:
Higher priorities place sources higher in the source selection. The video priority is the sum of the source priority and quality priority.

For example, source priority 3 plus quality priority 7 gives video priority 10.

Playback waits for source collection to finish unless you press Skip Loading. Priorities do not automatically skip collection. Skip starts an available source while remaining sources and subtitles continue loading. Your saved source preference and profile priorities still determine selection; hidden sources stay hidden.
